name: HitPay
summary: Reads a HitPay business into the books, and makes one write: a payment link on an issued invoice, which a person asks for. Charges, fees and payouts feed each money account; Fyniq never charges, refunds or pays out.

capabilities.trigger_rule: A verified HitPay webhook, which names an object to fetch, or the daily completeness sweep.
A person with a right on Invoices asks for a payment link on an issued invoice (FR-AR-13). Never the AI.
The sync schedule: the tick's hourly bank.sync, or an early sync a verified HitPay webhook prompts.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: HitPay's production, or its sandbox for staging.

history_days.title: History on the first sync
history_days.description: How many days before today the first sync reads charges and payouts.

secrets.name: api_key
secrets.title: Business API key
secrets.description: The business API key (Developers › API keys). Fyniq reads charges, payouts and balances with it and makes one kind of write, a payment request for an invoice's open balance; HitPay documents no read-only key, so keep it in this connector only.

secrets.name: webhook_salt
secrets.title: Webhook salt
secrets.description: The salt of the HitPay webhook endpoint that points to this connector's address, /api/webhooks/psp/hitpay/<this connector's ID> (Developers › Webhooks; not the API key's salt). It signs each webhook. Send it the charge and payout events.

health_check: Counts HitPay's refusals and failed connections in recent syncs, the webhooks received and parked, each feed's last sync and why it stopped, and the date each money account is complete to.
test_action: Lists the business's balance currencies, and reports whether HitPay accepted the key. It reads balances only.
local_substitute: A fake HitPay in tests with recorded fixtures; Prism serves contracts/partners/hitpay.yaml in the local partners profile.
